bagPolicy.summary: American Family Field enforces a clear bag policy to ensure guest safety and expedite entry. Approved bags include clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutches no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”.
allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags may have special exceptions.

parking.note: American Family Field has large on-site surface lots surrounding the ballpark in Milwaukee, with general and preferred options sold prepaid or at the gate. Tailgating is a tradition and permitted in the general lots. Lots open a couple hours before first pitch.

rideshare.note: The taxi cab drop off and pick up uses the transit area located outside Helfaer Field. Rideshare companies, such as Uber and Lyft, have a Rideshare Lot located on the south end of the Molitor Lot.

concessions.note: American Family Field offers a variety of food and drink options, including local and popular beers at the Beer Garden, comfort foods with a twist at Bridges Grille, and elevated ballpark classics at Cadillac Diner. Special offerings include a Bacon Wrapped Hot Dog and Pastrami Fry.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by American Family Field, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in American Family Field's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: An accessible ticket window (will call window #6) is located at the main American Family Field ticket office at the home plate entrance. Since tickets retrieved within the MLB Ballpark app will now be considered printed, the tickets will not be available for pickup at Will Call.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at American Family Field. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
